interface.signature: def sumK(root: TreeNode, K: int) -> int:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: root is either a TreeNode instance or None, representing an empty tree.
K is an integer within the range [-10^9, 10^9].

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) and hasattr(node, 'val') and hasattr(node, 'left') and hasattr(node, 'right') for node in [root] if node is not None)
preconditions.description: Every non-None node in the tree has attributes 'val' (integer), 'left' (TreeNode or None), and 'right' (TreeNode or None).

postconditions.description: return_value is a non-negative integer ≤ 10^5 (upper bound on node count) and equals the actual number of downward paths in the tree rooted at root whose node values sum to K. sumK_actual(root, K) is defined as the count of all paths starting at any node and ending at any descendant node (inclusive) where the sum of node values along the path equals K.
